about: Zero air is a synthetic air mixture of oxygen and nitrogen that is essentially free of hydrocarbons and other contaminants. Laboratories use it as a zero or baseline gas to calibrate analysers and as the oxidiser air for flame ionisation detectors (FID) in gas chromatographs.
Because it is blended rather than compressed from ambient air, its composition and cleanliness are consistent from cylinder to cylinder. Tell us your instrument’s purity requirement when you order.
